args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE NEW landscape1536x1024 transparent PNG KFB ink monster sheet, EXACTLY SIX UNIQUE CLOWN ARCHETYPES in THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Classic Auguste, female white-clown, sad Pierrot, female Venetian Colombina, Harlequin, court fool. Funny absurd-surreal handmade clay cartoon personalities, each a DIFFERENT KIND OF HUMOUR. No real performer likeness.
Both supplied PNGs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first for rounded whole charcoal-violet ink bodies, rich soft plasticine and modeled lids; second for exquisite clay props. New original subjects, not copies of reference faces/costumes.
EVERY actor a complete UPRIGHT FOOTLESS continuous dark charcoal-black ink blob, subtle deep purple sheen, thick soft asymmetric rounded lobes, face directly in goo, short rounded goo hands, a few contained detached droplets. No human torso/legs/feet, bust, human face, fur body or angular rock. Costumes only tiny hats/short collars/one shoulder fold/badge, most ink body exposed. Small intentional clown makeup accents only, never whitepaint the entire dark body or hide eyes. Tactile plasticine, rounded volumes, delicate fingerprints/seams/selective wear, weird offbeat cartoon charm, not generic Pixar mascots.
ALL actual eyes: WHITE/IVORY EYEBALL enclosing small RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL, thick fully purple-black sculpted eyelids. No glowing red eyeballs, spectacles or masks on faces. Six different facial proportions, lid weight, gaze, brow and mouth actions. Irregular ivory teeth where shown; no repeated open grins or dangling tongues. Two female-read characters in top-middle and bottom-left, conveyed subtly without human anatomy.
No scenery, circus set, pedestal, lettering, slogans, floating punctuation, confetti or gore. No horror character references.

TOP LEFT — MALE-READ AUGUSTE, innocent physical chaos. Huge broad pear blob with one drooping crown lobe, tiny battered navy bowler tilted back and one short oversized mustard lapel on shoulder. One small ROUND RED CLOWN NOSE below eyes, never hiding eyes. Explosive naive delight: one white eye enormous, other half-squinting sideways, unequal lifted brows, broad skewed laughing mouth with three uneven widely spaced teeth. Holds ONE squat brass SQUEEZE HORN, simple flared bell attached to short tube and large RED RUBBER BULB clearly squeezed by goo hand, other hand supporting tube. Entire horn low against belly within cell. No full clown suit or human gloves.
TOP MIDDLE — FEMALE-READ WHITE-CLOWN, comic perfectionist. Tall tapering soft pear with a coiled upper goo lobe, little IVORY CONE HAT with two black pom-poms, thin ivory pleated ruff only at upper body edge, two tiny IVORY CRESCENT CHEEK PAINT marks below eyes, dark ink face remains dominant. Supreme offended precision: very unequal half-lidded white eyes look DOWN, one brow high in judgment, tightly pursed asymmetric lip with one tiny projecting upper tooth. One hand holds ONE SHORT black conductor BATON with ivory tip at own belly; other flat goo palm balances ONE immaculate round RED RUBBER BALL. No magic, extra balls, mask or white human face.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ PIERROT, sincere deadpan melancholy. Compact round low dumpling splat with two small crown nubs, small soft ivory skullcap and one tiny ivory collar fold, TWO black costume buttons low on bare ink body, one small cream TEARDROP PAINT accent on cheek below eye. Huge sad white eyes glance SIDEWAYS, drooped inner brow corners and enormous sagging CLOSED lower lip, one single uneven lower tooth. Both hands protect ONE short drooping CLOTH FLOWER with green clay stem and ivory petals, bent gently downward at own wrist. No balloon, handkerchief stream, tears falling through scene or full white costume.
BOTTOM LEFT — FEMALE-READ VENETIAN COLOMBINA, knowing social wit. Broad wavy-edged ink splat, two short dark clay side curls, little faded RED cap with a small teal bow, short cream-and-red diamond collar panel at one shoulder only. Delighted incredulity: one huge white eye looking UP sideways and other narrowed with amusement, asymmetrically arched brows, nearly CLOSED crooked grin with one off-center small tooth. Holds ONE little partly opened ivory FAN low across own belly. Other hand dangles ONE small plain black-and-gold HALF-MASK by a short ribbon LOW beside her own hip, well BELOW face/eyes. Actual face fully uncovered; mask is subordinate inanimate prop, not an extra face on head. No feather tower, full gown or human bodice.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — MALE-READ HARLEQUIN, agile trickster pausing mid-scheme. Tall hooked kidney-shaped ink blob leaning slightly but fully upright, one sideways curled crown lobe. Little black felt cap with one soft drooping red tip, just THREE bold teal/red/ochre DIAMOND patches across one short shoulder sash, not full patterned human outfit. Focused sly mischief: mismatched white eyes peering SIDEWAYS in different squints, one eyebrow curling higher, small taut asymmetric lip-corner smile with two tiny unequal teeth. Both hands hold ONE SHORT WOODEN SLAPSTICK CLAPPER at own belly: TWO chunky pale wooden blades joined at one fat red handle, slightly separated so construction is clear. No stick hitting a neighbor, mask or acrobatic legs.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ COURT JESTER, sardonic truth-teller. Top-heavy near-square soft blob with three uneven low crown lobes, short three-point jester cap in muted wine-red and green, three chunky brass bells, one short matching pointed collar scrap. World-weary witty outrage: huge unequal white eyes rolling UP, one brow sharply lifted and other drooped, thick crooked compressed lower lip with two irregular teeth visible in shallow half-open sideways mouth. Holds ONE SHORT MAROTTE jester rattle upright close to own side, carved WOODEN DUMMY HEAD with a miniature cap at tip; tiny carved black eye grooves only, clearly a wooden prop, not another living monster. Free goo hand makes a small shrug at own belly. No crown, throne or full robe.

COMPOSITION: six LARGE self-contained figures in visually regular3x2 grid, similar substantial body height across rows. Whole silhouettes450-475px within each512pxlogical cell, safe outer margins and at least24-32px clear row gutters. All hats/bells/flower/horn/baton/ball/fan/low mask/clapper/marotte/droplets COMPLETE inside own cell. No overlapping/touching neighbors or cropped details. Never make bottom row miniature. No gridlines, text, watermark, background gradient, checkerboard, floor, shadow disc or halo. True alpha-zero transparent background, opaque character interiors and clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio light on characters only.
